fact: A habitable-zone super-Earth at Luyten's Star — and the target of a deliberate message from Earth.
bio: GJ 273 b, also called Luyten b, is a super-Earth in the temperate zone of Luyten's Star, only about 12 light-years away. In 2017–2018 the 'Sónar Calling GJ 273b' project beamed a coded radio message toward it from a radar in Norway — one of the few deliberate attempts to contact a specific nearby world, with any reply not due until the 2040s.
